summary: Icon Energy Corp, a Greek-domiciled Nasdaq-listed dry bulk shipper, furnished a Form 6-K press release titled 'Provides Commercial Update,' chronicling fleet employment rather than a transactional event. The fleet of three vessels (Panamax Alfa, Kamsarmax Bravo, Ultramax Charlie) operates on fixed and index-linked time charters; Alfa's index-linked hire was converted to a fixed $18,000/day for June-December 2026. Minimum contracted revenue is estimated near $11 million. Icon also disclosed a 4.6% passive equity co-investment in a 2008-built 2,000 TEU containership on charter to an investment-grade liner at $26,500/day through June 2028. No deal, vote, or board recommendation. Watch charter-market rates and co-investment sizing.
